parts.label: Sheet demo mobile effective viewport
upstream_facts: The upstream mobile snapshot was extracted at 375x240 CSS px.
fret_facts: The native diagnostics script must prove the effective layout root is 375x240 before comparing mobile sheet geometry.
On the current Windows native runner, requesting a 375x220 surface produces the required 375x240 effective layout root.

checks.expected: The Fret sidecar root should match the 375x240 viewport used by the upstream DOM snapshot.

promotion.reason: Viewport drift must be caught as runner evidence before component or mechanism geometry is compared.

parts.label: Sheet demo right-side mobile shell surface
upstream_facts: The default shadcn SheetContent side is right.
The right-side sheet owns inset-y-0 right-0 h-full w-3/4, with sm:max-w-sm applying only at the sm breakpoint.
At 375.333px wide, the upstream open panel is 281.5px wide and spans the full 240px viewport height.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery demo exposes a stable test id on the open SheetContent panel.
The diagnostics script captures a layout sidecar after the slide-in motion settles.

checks.expected: The right-side SheetContent panel should measure 281.5px wide, 240px tall, and start at x ~= 93.833 in the 375x240 mobile viewport.

promotion.reason: Right sheet shell sizing crosses overlay placement, viewport width fractions, and side-specific absolute layout.

parts.label: Sheet demo mobile field input widths and offsets
upstream_facts: The docs demo uses a flex-1 grid body with px-4 and gap-6.
Inputs fill the sheet content lane inside the 16px horizontal body padding.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery demo exposes stable test ids for the docs body and both profile inputs.
Body and input geometry are compared relative to the panel so shell position drift does not hide body layout drift.

checks.expected: The profile inputs should fill the upstream px-4 body lane and keep the docs-path vertical offsets relative to the sheet panel.

promotion.reason: The docs-path body composition is the reusable regression surface for Sheet demo field layout.

parts.label: Sheet demo mobile footer button stack
upstream_facts: SheetFooter owns mt-auto flex flex-col gap-2 p-4.
The default docs demo footer buttons stretch to the same px-4 content lane as the body inputs.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery demo exposes stable test ids for the sheet panel and both footer buttons.
Footer buttons may be clipped by the viewport, but their layout bounds remain deterministic in the sidecar.
The save button top offset is checked relative to the panel so a collapsed body flex item cannot pass by width alone.

checks.expected: The footer buttons should stay 248.833px wide, 36px tall, and separated by an 8px vertical gap in the mobile sheet.

promotion.reason: The SheetFooter vertical stack is recipe-owned and should stay locked once proven against the mobile docs demo.

limitations: This slice measures the official Sheet demo opened in the constrained 375x240 mobile viewport used by the upstream shadcn DOM golden.
Fret layout sidecar abs_rect values are logical px and compare directly against upstream DOM CSS px.
The slice separates the sheet shell from inner docs-path fields and footer buttons so shell sizing drift does not hide recipe or gallery-composition drift.
